reason: HelloAGENTS is primarily an orchestration workflow layer for AI coding CLIs, coordinating planning, execution, project context, verification, delivery checks, and resumable sessions.

summaries.zh: HelloAGENTS 是一个面向 AI 编程 CLI 的工作流编排层，用于协调规划、执行、项目知识、验证检查和可恢复会话。
summaries.en: HelloAGENTS is a workflow orchestration layer for AI coding CLIs that coordinates planning, execution, project knowledge, verification checks, and resumable sessions.

capabilities: Integrates workflow commands with AI coding CLIs
Writes project plans, knowledge-base files, session state, and runtime artifacts
Runs configured verification and quality-check commands
Supports resumable task execution and subagent result integration
